headline: NEW CANTATA HEARD AT ST. THOMAS'S
dispatch: Leipzig, Sept. 23. Johann Sebastian Bach yesterday directed the first performance of his new church cantata, Wer Dank opfert, der preiset mich, at St. Thomas's. The work, scored for chorus, solo voices and instruments, was given during the Sunday service.
answer: Bach premieres Cantata BWV 17 in Leipzig, 1726
